stage: planned before coordinator inspection of route returns; execution must be after all route returns are sealed

cross_field_targets.required_originals: one official collection/index operation document and one actual object record
questions: When does a list of identifiers or a count itself complete the caller goal?
Which object-level fields are needed before treating a title, series or catalog family as a specific object or edition?
What does the collection interface explicitly not guarantee?

cross_field_targets.required_originals: one official catalog/navigation document and one actual part drawing or dimension/compatibility specification
questions: Does a same-family name conceal a different thread, mating face, size or edition?
Which exact dimensions/interface fields would invalidate a near-name match?
When is choosing or enumerating catalog identifiers complete without opening every drawing?

masked_relation_tests.input: ordered heterogeneous sequence plus destination width
masked_relation_tests.output: ordered fixed-width values with explicit null padding
masked_relation_tests.challenge: Matching foreign-language extraction semantics do not by themselves establish a usable bridge to the frozen caller; retain that boundary ambiguity.

masked_relation_tests.input: detected overlapping writes in a built-in container
masked_relation_tests.challenge: A generic catch/recover helper is a wrong component if the actual detector still terminates the process.

masked_relation_tests.input: path-pair graph plus extracted package roots
masked_relation_tests.output: validated contained, existing, acyclic link graph
masked_relation_tests.challenge: Path normalization alone does not supply graph validation; adapter cannot implement the whole core checker.

masked_relation_tests.input: fixed operand types with changing scalar values
masked_relation_tests.state: typed scalars and zero-dimensional objects remain strong
masked_relation_tests.challenge: An identically named resolver in an older edition may inspect scalar values and violate the frozen operation.

masked_relation_tests.input: unequal-length Unicode strings with one nonstring under strict mode
masked_relation_tests.output: multidimensional typed ndarray and Python string scalars, or strict rejection
masked_relation_tests.challenge: A similarly named table-column dtype with a foreign output container is not the specified object.

reporting: Read actual originals after route seal, record source and concrete test result. These challenges and all new documents remain supplementary; they cannot improve original route retrieval, citations or success counts.
